moex:WTV6.usd_per_price_unit_basis: MOEX ISS description publishes UNIT=USD, but the exchange-published tick value (STEPPRICE 8.36177 RUB per MINSTEP 0.01 = 836.177 RUB/USD at USD/RUB 83.455) shows the lot is a fraction of the price unit: 1.0 of price movement is 10.01949554 USD per contract (exchange tick value per contract, per the official specification's variation-margin formula VM = dPrice x W/R).
